bindingMethod: committed repository records bound by exact SHA-256 at build time, with every relied-on statement re-read from the committed bytes as an anchor before composing
legalName: Petition for Mandatory Mistaken-Identity Expungement Under C.R.S. § 24-72-702 (Participant Filing After the Expired 90-Day Agency Deadline)
formIdentityNote: The controlling decision records that no dedicated statewide JDF form was located for a § 24-72-702 mistaken-identity expungement and directs a custom civil petition with a listed set of contents. Both filing pages are therefore composed by this build from that committed decision, carrying exactly the listed contents. Colorado's JDF sealing forms serve other routes and other families; none was substituted and none was invented.

committedRecords.role: the controlling research-track decision: the agency-first mechanism, the participant branch this family implements, the no-fee rule, the custom petition's required contents, and the recorded boundaries

identityRefresh.why: The record was rewritten around this receipt's anchors. 13 named entries moved between the blob carrying the previous pin and the bytes on disk (question:Q-002:ky_felony_expungement_after_pardon, question:Q-003:ky_felony_vacatur_expungement, question:Q-004:ky_nonconviction_expungement, question:Q-006:la-978-felony-conviction, question:Q-007:la-985-3-immediate-expungement, question:Q-008:la-985-expungement-by-redaction, question:Q-019:nd-dui-record-seal, question:Q-020:nd-dui-record-seal, question:Q-023:ne-expunge-le-error, question:Q-024:ne-expunge-le-error, question:Q-025:ne-expunge-le-error, question:Q-026:ne-seal-pardoned, question:Q-027:ne-seal-pardoned), and this receipt anchors no entry that moved: every entry it binds, and this record's global authority fields, were recovered from that blob and compared object-for-object, order-independent, against the current record, and all 2 were identical.
identityRefresh.canonicalisation: keys sorted recursively, JSON.stringify with no spacing, one trailing newline, UTF-8

recoveredFrom.method: git rev-list --all -- <path>, deduplicated by blob id, each blob hashed until the pin matched

identityRefresh.whatThisDoesNotClaim: Nothing about the packet's bytes, its obligations, its counters or its verdict. It restores an identity binding that lapsed on an edit to entries this family does not bind, and it opens no route and grants no approval.

whatThisReceiptDoesNotEstablish: that any output is approved for participant delivery
that any record is eligible for the relief this family composes for
that any agency made a mistaken-identity finding in any particular case, or that no charges were filed
that the 90-day agency deadline has expired in any particular case
